ui_bugs.issue: Alliance name still truncates with ellipsis on 390px viewport: 'Gruplandırılmamış' shows ellipsis because the inner span uses maxWidth:'40vw' + textOverflow:ellipsis (measured scrollWidth > clientWidth). Feature #2 asked truncation to be fixed — raise maxWidth (e.g. min(60vw, ...)) or let the name wrap.

issues: React error: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.' The alliance header is a <button> containing nested interactive controls (AllianceScopeToggle renders a real <button>; the new edit control was worked around as <span role=button>). Restructure the header as a div with a separate collapse <button> so nested-button/hydration errors and a11y issues go away.

React warning: 'Removing/updating a style property during rerender when a conflicting property is set can lead to styling bugs' fires on /uyeler (likely the swatch/preview inline transform+boxShadow styles in AllianceEditModal).

React error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' — one of the <select> option labels on the Sertifika Ver page renders an element (i18n/Trans or emoji wrapper) inside <option>. Use plain strings for option children (cert-event-picker / cert-theme-picker / issued-cert-edit-theme).

action_items: Fix alliance header name truncation for long names (e.g. 'Gruplandırılmamış') — maxWidth 40vw is too small on mobile.
Resolve nested <button> inside the alliance header button (hydration error) — make the header a div + explicit collapse button.
Remove element children from <select><option> on the Sertifika Ver page (hydration error).
critical_code_review_comments: Members.jsx is 2513 lines — split AllianceEditModal / AllianceColorPicker / member card into separate files (>700 line rule).

AllianceEditModal.save(): if rename succeeds but the following PUT /alliance-colors fails, the user sees only the error toast while the rename already committed — no rollback and no state indication; consider saving the color first or surfacing partial success.

AllianceEditModal.resetColor() always deletes the color of state.old even if the user has typed a new name in the same session — after a rename+reset combination the stale key can remain in alliance-colors.

PATCH /certificates: silently coercing an unknown theme to 'amber' hides client bugs; returning 400 for an invalid theme would be more correct (current behaviour matches the spec, so this is informational).
Member title span uses overflow:visible with maxWidth:60 — a long unvan will visually spill outside the 28px rank column; clamp with ellipsis or allow the column to grow.
